import text

identifiers := [
    "user_name", "maxRetryCount", "ShoppingCartItem", "background-color", "get_last_login_time",
    "isEmailAddressValid",
]
for identifier := identifiers[]
    words := text.identifier.snake(identifier).split("_")
    snake := words.join("_")
    camel := text.identifier.camel(snake)
    pascal := text.identifier.pascal(snake)
    kebab := words.join("-")
    println("{identifier}: snake={snake}, camel={camel}, pascal={pascal}, kebab={kebab}")
